CustomField.description: Whose logic this tool runs: Standard for Pluto Core's own tools, Flow for an admin-built Flow, Apex for a custom ITool class. Core copies it from the tool type on every save, so it is reportable and never disagrees with the tool type.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set by Pluto Core from the Tool Type. Standard runs Core's own logic, Flow runs the configured Flow, and Apex runs a custom class.
CustomField.label: Implementation Type
